description:
This has most of the custom foreground graphics I used for my KLDC except for custom blocks, there's some unused things I threw in there because why not? I just don't recommend using them in the same level because they kinda clash together. Or maybe do, I'm not your parent, idk.
A lot of them are based on Vanilla Castle tiles.
